_comment: What the installer carries, and what it fetches only when asked. Sizes and hashes are filled in by fetch_payloads.py from the real downloads - never hand-edited, so the manifest is measured rather than claimed.

bundled._comment: Ships inside the installer. Setting these capabilities up needs no network at all.

python.why: Optional tools run in their own environments. Used only when the machine has no Python 3.13 already, and installed per-user, never system-wide.

wheels._comment: pip download --only-binary=:all: per capability. imageio-ffmpeg carries the ffmpeg binary, so media needs no separate ffmpeg download.

on_request._comment: Too large, or third-party installers better taken fresh from their vendor. Each states its source and size before anything is downloaded, and is checked against its hash afterwards.

tailscale.why: Private access from your phone and other devices.

node.why: YouTube signature checks, and the OpenCode agent runtime.

speech_wheels._comment: ctranslate2 + av + onnxruntime are ~80% of a fully-bundled installer's weight, to serve one optional feature. Fetched when TALK speech is set up.

speech_models._comment: Downloaded by packaging/speech_worker.py only after an explicit model choice.

youtube_upload._comment: ~15 MB. Fetched from PyPI when YouTube upload is first set up.

mcp._comment: ~26 MB (numpy, pillow, pywin32). Fetched from PyPI when PC control is first set up.
